job.title: EOI for Bus Drivers
job.description:
Goal Indigenous Services are looking for Full-Time Bus Drivers to join our team across Melbourne.

Bus Drivers play an essential role in keeping our communities connected. Every day is different, with opportunities to deliver a range of services including route services, school runs, Night Network services, charter runs and special events.

If you enjoy driving, value great customer service and want to make a positive impact in your local community, this could be the perfect opportunity for you!

Key Responsibilities:
  • Safely transport passengers across Melbourne
  • Provide friendly and professional customer service
  • Complete route services, school runs, charter services and special events
  • Follow all road rules, safety procedures and regulations
  • Help create a safe and positive experience for passengers
Skills and Experience:
  • Current Victorian HR licence
  • Heavy vehicle driving experience – preferred but not essential
  • A strong customer focus and willingness to assist passengers
  • A demonstrated safe driving record
  • A high regard for safety, road rules and regulations
  • The ability to obtain relevant medical and background clearances
  • Ability to obtain Driver Accreditation (DC) 6 or more demerit points
  • Ability to obtain a Working With Children Check (WWCC)
  • Police check
Benefits
  • Variety of driving services and work locations across Melbourne
  • Opportunity to build your career in the transport industry
  • Be part of a team that values community, safety and great customer service
  • Make a genuine difference by helping keep communities connected
Ready to get behind the wheel?

If you’re an experienced drive or a confident MR-licenced driver looking to take the next step—we’d love to hear from you!

Apply today and come drive with us!

job.title: Business Development Manager
job.description:
Goal Indigenous Services are seeking a skilled & motivated Business Development Manager to join our client in Rowville, Melbourne Victoria. 

Responsibilities:
• Acquire new Commercial & Industrial clients through lead databases & active prospecting
• Build & manage a healthy pipeline of qualified opportunities
• Manage & convert inbound & outbound Commercial & Industrial leads
• Deliver tailored proposals & recommend energy solutions aligned to client goals
• Build strong, ongoing client relationships
• Use CRM tools to manage daily workflow & reporting
• Prepare client presentations highlighting energy savings & sustainability benefits
• Educate clients on energy efficiency options including solar, battery, & LED

Essential:
• Driver's license & own vehicle
• Strong analytical & problem-solving skills
• Driven, confident communicator with a proactive, target-focused mindset
• High level of computer literacy

Desired:
• 2+ years' sales experience (phone-based or face-to-face). Sales experience preferred but not essential. We're after someone honest, hardworking, willing to learn & we will teach the energy side on the job.
• Energy sector experience

Benefits:
• A genuine long-term pathway to equity in the business for high performers
• Reward & recognition program celebrating loyalty & achievement
• Birthday leave plus an annual Wellbeing Day
• Clear career development pathways
• Coaching & mentorship from industry leaders
• The chance to help build the Indigenous economy

Apply now via our website or send your resume to cclyne@goalis.com.au

job.title: Administration Assistant
job.description:

Responsibilities:
  • Coordinating and maintaining fleet-related data, systems, administration, and processes
  • Providing varied administration assistance to a busy fleet team as required
  • In house system processing of fleet repair work orders, raising purchase orders in line with Company compliance requirements.
  • Assist with management of repairs & servicing of equipment
  • Liaise with drivers, suppliers and other stakeholders to ensure the smooth running of fleet operations
  • Entering meter readings
  • Raising and closing work orders 
  • General administration duties
Essential:
  • Customer service orientated
  • Experience working in a similar position with exposure to multiple stakeholders.
  • Experience working within the road transport industry
  • Skilled with use of Microsoft Office suite and fleet management software
  • Ability to work autonomously and as part of a team
  • High attention to detail
Ideal:
  • JDE/Preceda/UKG experience highly regarded
  • Understanding of Chain of Responsibility (CoR) legislation
Benefits:
  • Great work-life balance
  • Work with a dynamic and supportive work environment
If this sounds like the role for you or someone you know, apply now via our website or send your resume to acollins@goalis.com.au

job.title: Labourer and Trade Assistants
job.description:
We are seeking dedicated and motivated Labourers & Trade Assistants to join our team in Darwin. This is a fantastic opportunity to work on exciting construction projects in a dynamic and supportive environment.

Whether you have experience or are new to the field, we welcome all applications.

Key Responsibilities:
  • Assisting tradespeople with construction tasks including site preparation, material handling, and equipment operation.
  • General labouring duties such as moving materials, maintaining a clean site, and following safety protocols.
  • Supporting the setup and teardown of scaffolding and temporary structures.
  • Operating power tools and machinery under supervision.
  • Following instructions from supervisors and site managers to meet project deadlines.
Skills & Experience
  • A strong commitment to safety and willingness to follow safety procedures.
  • Ability to work effectively as part of a team.
  • Good physical fitness and stamina for manual labour.
  • A positive attitude and willingness to learn.
Requirements:
  • Ability to work in outdoor conditions and on active construction sites.
  • Valid White Card 
  • Drivers Licence
  • Ability to pass a pre-employment medical and drug/alcohol test if required.
Benefits
  • Weekly pay
  • Exclusive access to our benefits platform that offers savings at over 60 major Australian Retailers across the country.

We Welcome Every Applicant We believe diversity makes us stronger. All people with the right skills, attitude and motivation are encouraged to apply.

Apply via the website link or email your resume to Cecilia at cewatts@goalis.com.au

job.description:

  • Assisting with painting and surface preparation where required

  • Following site safety procedures and supervisor instructions
Requirements:
  • Current Confined Space Entry ticket – essential
  • Construction White Card
  • Previous Trade Assistant or similar hands-on experience
  • Painting or surface preparation experience highly regarded
  • Current Driver’s Licence
  • Ability to travel to remote NT locations as required
  • Good level of physical fitness
  • Strong commitment to workplace safety
  • Ability to work well within a team and follow instructions

Benefits:
  • Monday to Friday – 10-hour days
  • Travel, Accommodation, Meals provided
  • Opportunities across Darwin, Katherine and Jabiru
  • Mix of local and remote project work
  • Varied, hands-on work across different sites
Apply via Seek link or email Cecilia at cewatts@goalis.com.au

  • Litter collection and rubbish removal.
  • General site clean-up.

  • Previous grounds maintenance, gardening or handyman experience is highly regarded.
  • Good physical fitness and ability to complete manual outdoor work.
  • Reliable with a strong work ethic.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

  • Australian Citizen or Permanent Resident.

  • Exclusive access to our benefits platform that offers savings at over 60 major Australian retailers across the country.

job.title: Human Resources Officer
job.description:
We're seeking a proactive Human Resources Officer to support all aspects of the employee lifecycle while helping to build a positive, high-performing workplace culture.

About the Role This is a true generalist HR role where you'll work closely with managers and employees across the organisation, providing advice, support and guidance on a broad range of human resources matters.

Key Responsibilities
  • Manage the end-to-end employee lifecycle, including recruitment, onboarding and offboarding.
  • Provide advice on HR policies, procedures, employment legislation, awards and performance management.
  • Support employee relations, conflict resolution, grievances and workplace investigations.
  • Maintain accurate HR records, systems and confidential employee information.
  • Assist with learning and development, performance reviews and workforce planning.
  • Contribute to policy development, compliance activities and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Build strong relationships with managers, employees and external stakeholders.
  • Promote a positive workplace culture through professional HR support and coaching.
Requirements:
  • Qualifications in Human Resources or relevant HR experience.
  • Experience in a generalist HR position.
  • Sound knowledge of Fair Work legislation, awards and HR best practices.
  • Experience with recruitment, performance management and employee relations.
  • Excellent communication and relationship-building skills.
  • Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage competing priorities.
  • High attention to detail and the ability to maintain confidentiality.
Essentials for the role:
  • Current NT C-Class Driver's Licence.
  • Working with Children Clearance (or ability to obtain).
  • National Police Check (or ability to obtain).
  • International Police Check (if applicable).
Desirable:
  • Knowledge of the Northern Territory and/or the Vocational Education and Training (VET) sector.
Benefits:
  • Supportive and collaborative team environment.
  • Professional development and ongoing learning opportunities.
  • Diverse role with exposure across all areas of Human Resources.
  • Opportunity to make a meaningful impact within the organisation.
  • Long-term career growth and development opportunities.
Apply via the Seek Link or email your resume to Cecilia at cewatts@goalis.com.au
